name: Summer is the Sea
overview: A travel show about how to have a nice and high-quality vacation in Russia. The audience will go on a road trip to the Crimean peninsula together with a married couple of food bloggers Anton and Camilla Dmitriev. On the way from Moscow to the south, the guys will visit the coolest locations in the country's regions, teach them how to pose for photos correctly, cook the biggest burger and tell them where it's best to spend the night.
